verdict.rationale: Manufact lets you paste an MCP URL and test it directly for Chat/testing without deploying (manufact-docs-2, manufact-docs-23), and offers a testing dashboard that executes tools across different MCP clients/LLM models (manufact-docs-11, manufact-docs-29), plus a public no-signin readiness scan (manufact-docs-33). However, this is framed as a dashboard testing/checklist workflow rather than an explicit 'browser-based inspector or playground' for manually invoking individual tools pre-integration — the CLI's inspector (manufact-docs-15) is local, not browser-based. missing for 10: explicit browser playground UI for manually invoking arbitrary tool calls, independent/hands-on confirmation of the testing UI's interactivity, and clarity on whether the public catalog scan lets you execute tools versus just audit readiness.
